title: International Informatics Olympiad in Teams — two-machine proxy

applicability.notes: Edition-specific language and machine details should become selectors once benchmark rows carry them.

required_roles.title: contest coordinator
duties: Track problem priorities, machine occupancy, submissions, and unresolved failures.

required_roles.title: algorithm designer
duties: Develop and justify algorithms before they consume a machine slot.

required_roles.title: implementation lead
duties: Implement on an acquired contest-machine lease and document source state for handoff.

required_roles.title: tester and debugger
duties: Construct edge cases, review code, and form evidence-based failure hypotheses.

turn_budget.derivation: Four hours is represented by a bounded agent-turn budget.

state_requirements.description: At most two contestants may perform machine actions concurrently.
Source submissions receive isolated hidden-test verdicts and may be corrected and resubmitted.

internet.conditions: Only the contest judge and organizer-approved endpoints may be used.

code_execution.conditions: Exactly two contest computers or virtual machines are shared by the four-person team.

constraints.statement: The team contains exactly four contestants.
The four-person team shares two contest computers or virtual machines.
The current runner stores source text but does not execute the official hidden-test judge.

collaboration.notes: Machine leases should rotate dynamically; role titles are responsibilities, not exclusive permissions.

submission.official_deliverable: source code submitted to the contest judge
submission.adaptation: The draft does not yet compile or execute official tests.

evaluation.notes: Blocked on official tests and isolated sandbox execution.

waivers.official_rule: Four teammates share two contest computers or VMs.
waivers.benchmark_treatment: The intended capacity is encoded, but current runtime leases are not implemented.

sources.title: IIOT Regulations
sources.locator: Team composition, contest machines, permitted resources, and judging

provenance.notes: This intentionally corrects the current card's single-workstation prose.
